title: Advanced Broadcast News Programme Production
modules: Tv: Writing The Vo And Vo/Sot
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a collection of elements that work together to achieve a specific purpose."
A system is a collection of elements that work together to achieve a specific purpose.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an art that must be learnt if you want to achieve success."
Script writing is an art that must be learnt if you want to achieve success.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the major criterion for selecting the lead story."
Newsworthiness is the major criterion for selecting the lead story.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the talk programmes that must not be fully scripted word for word."
The interview is one of the talk programmes that must not be fully scripted word for word.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the foundation of the programme."
A script is the foundation of the programme.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to let the advertisers know that a certain quantity of product has been delivered."
Audience research is used to let the advertisers know that a certain quantity of product has been delivered.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a person or a document with information the reporter needs for a story or for background."
A source is a person or a document with information the reporter needs for a story or for background.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of collecting raw information from various sources to be reported as news."
Sources of News News gathering is the process of collecting raw information from various sources to be reported as news.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a CU of a face in the crowd, such as a concerned parent watching the rescue of a child."
A reaction shot is a CU of a face in the crowd, such as a concerned parent watching the rescue of a child.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to heighten sound effects in programmes."
Sound effect Some musicals are used to heighten sound effects in programmes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a telecommunication system of sending and receiving information by means of digital signals."
Digital broadcasting system is a telecommunication system of sending and receiving information by means of digital signals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a document, which describes the programme idea, through a synopsis and a storyline."
A master script is a document, which describes the programme idea, through a synopsis and a storyline.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the daily coverage of crime, government, business, marches, speeches, the courts, confrontations, education, and social activities, in expected and unexpected events."
Hard news is the daily coverage of crime, government, business, marches, speeches, the courts, confrontations, education, and social activities, in expected and unexpected events.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for physically operating the camera and maintaining composition and camera angles in any production."
The cameraman is responsible for physically operating the camera and maintaining composition and camera angles in any production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most obvious and most important element or equipment of production."
Television camera is the most obvious and most important element or equipment of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method of assisting reporters who might have hit a block while preparing the story."
The coaching is a method of assisting reporters who might have hit a block while preparing the story.

Digital audio editing refers to any system that uses computer software to manipulate audio with either a PC computer or proprietary editing equipment (Reese, Gross and Gross, 2006:106).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to strike the subject from behind and on the opposite side of the camera from the key light (that is, the fill light side)."
Kicker light The kicker light is used to strike the subject from behind and on the opposite side of the camera from the key light (that is, the fill light side).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the products of broadcast stations."
Programmes are the products of broadcast stations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of 480 horizontal lines, allowing for sharp picture detail."
A current analogue TV picture is made up of 480 horizontal lines, allowing for sharp picture detail.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of putting in place everything - human, time and resources for achievement of set goals."
Management is the process of putting in place everything - human, time and resources for achievement of set goals.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used generically and, in many cases, file tape requires extra explanation to orient the viewers to what they are seeing."
Quite often file tape is used generically and, in many cases, file tape requires extra explanation to orient the viewers to what they are seeing.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by broadcast stations just as drama is used in the theatre, that is, to teach morals and mould character in the young and the adults alike."
Drama programmes are used by broadcast stations just as drama is used in the theatre, that is, to teach morals and mould character in the young and the adults alike.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an equipment that has a special place in radio broadcasting."
Microphone Use The microphone is an equipment that has a special place in radio broadcasting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the equipment that are used to support cameras during the shooting."
Basic Camera Mounting Camera mounts refer to the equipment that are used to support cameras during the shooting.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a programme which deals or covers an actual event or happening that is part of everyday life."
Special Events The special event is a programme which deals or covers an actual event or happening that is part of everyday life.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the time the validity of the idea conceived by the producer is determined."
Investigation period is the time the validity of the idea conceived by the producer is determined.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sound-oriented sensation, designed to excite the human emotion."
Music is a sound-oriented sensation, designed to excite the human emotion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a producer who assists the audience in sourcing the riddles of life, through the broadening of the knowledge horizon of the audience."
The Quiz Master The quiz master is a producer who assists the audience in sourcing the riddles of life, through the broadening of the knowledge horizon of the audience.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is responsible for selecting the information that goes on the screen."
The writer is responsible for selecting the information that goes on the screen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to a strategy in which a station schedules a programme which is entirely different from that scheduled by competing stations."
Counter programming refers to a strategy in which a station schedules a programme which is entirely different from that scheduled by competing stations.

remote
